name: Biochar
principle: Biomass is pyrolysed to a stable carbon-rich solid that is put on soils or into materials, locking in carbon for centuries. In 2024 total delivered carbon dioxide removal was 318,600 t, up 120%, and Exomad Green alone delivered 107,000 t of biochar CO2 removal; biochar purchases were a large share of the nearly 8 Mt contracted.

performance.basis: described as 'to date'; total CDR deliveries 318,600 t in 2024; only 4.4% of booked volume delivered

source.note: Biochar Today, Biochar's big year: 107,000 tonnes delivered amid 8m tonne carbon removal boom (cdr.fyi 2024 data)
